entities.name: Roreca
entities.description: Familiar of the planeswalker Worzel and narrator of "Roreca's Tale"; a furred creature able to sniff out leylines.

entities.name: Scryb Sprites
entities.description: Sprites often summoned by Worzel who stole some of Roreca's fur.

events.summary: The Scryb Sprites steal a square foot of Roreca's fur for a bedspread.
events.quote: they once stole a square foot of her fur to make a bedspread

events.summary: Roreca endures great pain as Worzel heals her; the fur is replaced by a tattoo.
events.quote: The familiar endured great pain during Worzel's efforts to heal her

relations.quote: Roreca was the planeswalker Worzel 's familiar
